sentences.text: Capellineosuchus is an extinct genus of mosasaur.
The genus was discovered in Italy and originally described by Simonelli as a crocodyliform related to Dakosaurus.
Sirotti later re-examined the type specimen and concluded that Capellineosuchus was a junior synonym of Mosasaurus hoffmannii.
A 2014 study determined that the genus is distinct from Mosasaurus hoffmannii.
The name Capellineosuchus is a misspelling created by Romer.
The Paleobiology Database lists the parent group as Metriorhynchidae.
Fossils of this animal date to the Late Cretaceous period.
